title: Zucchini Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Rinse the chicken, remove excess fat, and pat dry.
Shred the unpeeled zucchini in a food processor or grate on the large holes of a hand grater.

In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan, melt the margarine and add the zucchini. Cook, stirring, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Grate or shred the bread into crumbs and add to the zucchini. Stir in the egg and seasonings, mixing well.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees. Carefully loosen the skin on each chicken quarter to form a pocket and spoon 1/4 of the stuffing into each.
Brush each quarter with honey and bake for 60 minutes until tender.
notes: From the family cookbook (p. 13). Uses a 10-inch skillet, a 1 1/2-quart saucepan, and a roasting pan. The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of zucchini-stuffed chicken.
